title: Leaving A Legacy - Elevate Branson
summary: Your legacy could be written on the lives of our neighbors.

paragraphs: Your legacy could be written on the lives of our neighbors.
Let us help you plan your giving options.
Bequest a gift made through your will or trust to continue supporting Elevate Branson, or a specific program of your choice.
Tiny homes, sponsorship packages, and many other opportunities within Elevate Community allow you to leave your name and legacy to empower our neighbors in our community.
Set up your trust to allocate an amount of your choosing to help fund Elevate Branson programs and services.
Include Elevate Branson as a beneficiary of your life insurance plan to leave your mark on our community.
To Leave Your Legacy, Contact Matt Grindstaff At [email protected] or 417.598.0962.
